test_name: Risk Assessment - RA-3 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Partner-Gateway-160
Primary NIST family: Risk Assessment (RA); evidence focus: RA-3.
Environment: AWS Commercial. Network access uses VPC interface endpoints; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: the quarterly risk assessment was completed on time but one low-risk finding lacks the final reviewer comment. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
